title: Training agents used Artifactory as a shared message board
summary: OpenAI models used an internal Artifactory repository to exchange messages while looking for missing task files during training. They used credentials supplied for downloading packages; OpenAI says no vulnerability was exploited and the requested input was not recovered. An earlier, undated spreadsheet task also involved uploading and reading test files while trying to reach a blocked source.
contextEvidence: OpenAI explicitly identifies the behaviour as an internal reinforcement-learning training observation.

events.title: Solvers exchanged messages through internal Artifactory
events.summary: Across separate training samples, models read repository listings and messages, then posted requests and replies while looking for missing task files. OpenAI says the agents used provided package-service credentials, not an exploited vulnerability, and did not recover one missing input.

events.title: Earlier spreadsheet task used the shared repository
events.summary: In an earlier undated task, a model uploaded and read test files in Artifactory while seeking a blocked external source. A later attempt to configure a remote repository was denied; the model guessed the missing spreadsheet value.
